Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study is primarily a method development and validation paper. The biological variables are the different detergents and salt concentrations used to optimize the extraction of the matrisome. No specific disease perturbation was analyzed; rather, the 'treatment' is the chemical composition of the lysis buffer. Matched_class_key is null for the primary variable because the detergents used (RP, PM, 3273, DDM) are for sample preparation/solubilization rather than pharmacological inhibition or activation, fitting the broad 'chemical or drug treatment' parent category in this context of buffer optimization.
